name: @finapp/m28-executive-ai
description: M28 — Executive Copilot (Stage 5, GOVERNED, mvp:partial): a READ-ONLY executive assistant that answers questions and produces CITED cross-domain summaries (operations, finance, legal, feedback, cases, KPIs, trends, risk, exceptions, portfolio) for MD/CEO/COO/CFO. Every substantive answer is EVIDENCE-BACKED (citations, human-verifiable) and RLS-MASKED (a caller only ever receives data their tenant + row-level entitlements already permit — the copilot never expands the caller's authority, never infers across tenants and never leaks masked rows or counts). It NEVER mutates a business record, approves, posts, disburses, reconciles, closes a case, files a matter, sends a notification, changes roles/rules/workflow or executes any controlled action — AI assists, a human decides (CLAUDE.md). It consumes the M24 governed AI pipeline BY CONTRACT (no second AI engine, no provider/routing/DLP), defers the UNBUILT M32 analytics behind a read-only ExecutiveAnalyticsPort (deterministic doubles; fail closed when unavailable), reads cross-domain modules only through read-only ports, audits every action under the shared AI_ prefix (AI_COPILOT_*), shares the m24 ai.* permission namespace (ai.copilot.*), and owns NO second outbox and NO new event family. Confidence is integer basis points; large question/answer content lives behind M09 document references; no float, no secret column. No production provider, no network, no HTTP client.
